neighbours.label: a size word (large, small, entire, growing) describing a group or population rather than a single thing
fire: The virus spread through the island's large population of seals.
The city has a small but growing Muslim community.
Russia then comprised a large peasant mass.
The general lost his entire army in the winter.
The town has a small tax base and few shops.
An entire generation of workers lost their jobs.
A large crowd of protesters filled the square.
The country has a growing middle class.
quiet: The virus was seen under a large microscope.
The city has a small but lovely garden.
Russia then built a large wooden palace.
The general lost his favorite horse in the winter.
The town has a small church and a shop.
An entire wall of the house fell down.
A large box of apples sat in the square.
The country has a growing rail network.

short: size of a group or population
